title: Count and reverse characters, emoji included

blocks.text: `length()` counts UTF-16 `char` units, not the characters a reader sees. A character outside the Basic Multilingual Plane, such as the emoji `"\uD83D\uDE00"`, takes two units (a surrogate pair): its `length()` is `2`, while `codePointCount(0, 2)` is `1`.

items: `characters(String s)` returns how many characters `s` holds, an emoji counting once: `characters("abc")` is `3`, and `characters("a\uD83D\uDE00")` is `2`.
`reverse(String s)` returns the characters in reverse order, keeping each emoji whole: `reverse("abc")` is `"cba"`, and `reverse("a\uD83D\uDE00")` is `"\uD83D\uDE00a"`.

cases.says: "a" followed by an emoji has 2 characters, not 3.
Reversing "a" and an emoji keeps the emoji's two units in order.

concepts: length() counts UTF-16 char units, so an emoji counts two, while codePointCount counts characters.
